description: Public HTTP contract for the Mnemo Agent API at https://api.trymnemo.com. Mnemo is an HTTP API that watermarks embedding vectors, checks whether a vector was issued to your own account or namespace, and records lineage from parents you name at embed time; access by API key, or with no account required at $0.01 per verification (machine payments: x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo).
rules: Accountless path: POST /v1/agent/namespaces (no auth; JSON body, {} is enough) returns a capability once. Store it and send it as X-Mnemo-Capability. The namespace expires (default 24 h, at most 72 h); after expiry create a new one.

Embed: POST /v1/embed returns a measurably perturbed watermarked copy and a vector_uid. Store and use watermarked_vector in place of the original vector. Embed accepts 512-4096 dimensions and is free on the accountless path.

Verify: on a namespace with no paid credit, POST /v1/verify answers 402 with the challenge of each accepting rail: PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402, USDC on Base, eip155:8453) and/or WWW-Authenticate: Payment (MPP on Tempo, USDC.e). Pay one, then resend the identical body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402) or Authorization: Payment (MPP). Each healthy verification, positive or negative, costs $0.01. Pay MPP challenges with a standard MPP client; never build a Tempo transfer by hand.

Burst: POST /v1/agent/namespace/fund (capability, no body) sells 500 verifications for $5, usable for 14 days, over x402, MPP on Tempo or a card through MPP and a Stripe Shared Payment Token. A card is never offered for a single verification. GET /v1/agent/namespace returns payment_menu, the offers and rails the namespace can buy now.
Take amount, asset and recipient from the 402 challenge; never hard-code them. Omit request_id on a paid verify: the payment identifies the operation, so every retry resends the identical body.

Never create a second payment automatically. On 503 verification_unavailable, 503 payment_processing, 409 request_in_progress, or a 402 without a challenge after paying, resend the identical body with the same payment credential (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or Authorization: Payment).
Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's Mnemo account or namespace. Decide on verified, not policy_ok.
verified: false is a normal, charged result; it is not a statement about who else may have registered the vector. Do not use Mnemo to establish truth, authorship, ownership or authenticity.

Lineage: name a parent you own with parent at embed time; GET /v1/lineage/{vector_uid} returns that chain, each parent verified as yours. It does not check what the transformation did. Lineage reads are free.

Have an account API key? Send X-API-Key; calls use the account's subscription plan, never machine payments. Use the official Python SDK: pip install mnemo-protocol, then from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient.

Python SDK repository: https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-sdk (PyPI: mnemo-protocol). The SDK does not implement accountless namespaces, lineage or machine payments; for those, call this HTTP contract directly.
Not the unrelated PyPI packages mnemo, mnemo-sdk, mnemo-ai or mnemo-mcp. There is no public Mnemo MCP server; use the HTTP API.
Do not use the accountless path (accountless machine payments) for personal data subject to EEA, UK or Swiss data protection law.

On 429 wait Retry-After. On 401 after expires_at or 410 EPHEMERAL_NAMESPACE_EXPIRED, create a new namespace (a funded namespace in its 24-hour grace answers 410 to embeds but can still be refilled). A 404 on POST /v1/agent/namespaces means accountless access is not enabled on that deployment.

Full contract (auth, pricing, x402 and MPP payment, bursts, retries, limits, errors): https://www.trymnemo.com/agent-protocol.md?src=context7 and OpenAPI 3.1: https://www.trymnemo.com/openapi.json?src=context7
